Earl Derr Biggers, Behind That Curtain.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/earl-derr-biggers/behind-that-curtain

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Earl Derr Biggers, the author, died 1933 (Wikidata Q983421, P570 = 1933-04-05).

First publication of the text used: 1928 (SE colophon: 'Behind That Curtain was published in 1928 by Earl Derr Biggers.'). The Wikipedia article on the novel gives the publisher as Bobbs-Merrill and the release as 1928, and its infobox gives the country as the United States.

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in the United States in 1928, before 1931, so the US rule settles the country of origin too. A published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so this work entered it on 1 January 2024.
- Country of origin (United States, first publication 1928): see the paragraph above. The author's death year (1933) does not change this, because the US rule settles the origin whatever the death year.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
